Hi Lena — thanks for the heads up and the screenshot. Sorry you're hitting this during a PO crunch.

Quick troubleshooting steps in order of speed:
1) Try an incognito window (Ctrl+Shift+N) and retry the link — that often avoids stale SSO cookies.
2) If that fails, try a different device (phone or a colleague's laptop) and confirm whether the same error appears.
3) Confirm the browser console error (if your IT can capture it) — a short screenshot of the console helps.

If those don't work I can escalate an ops fallback: we can manually mark the vendor active and send an admin-created link so the PO becomes visible. To do that I need:
- Legal vendor name exactly as on your W9
- Vendor tax ID (EIN) or DUNS
- The PO number that needs to be visible

I'm attaching our onboarding checklist in case it helps with quick verification. If you give me the vendor name + TAX ID I can queue manual activation and loop Ben for final sign-off.

Thanks for the ping. I dug into the auth logs for the invite token from Novacorp and see the following: when the browser attempts the FIDO registration the RP origin check fails against our new passkey policy (we tightened allowed origins for third-party SSO last month). That triggers an enrollment abort upstream in the SSO layer, which is why the UX goes to the grey error screen.

Workarounds I can do quickly (requires ops approval from Ben):
1) Manual activation (preferred): I can create the vendor record and mark it verified so the PO is visible immediately. This is an elevated, audited action — I'll need written approval from Ben and the vendor legal name + TAX ID.
2) Admin invite link: I can issue an admin-created invite that bypasses the browser passkey registration and instead forces email OTP enrollment. This is less privileged and reversible.

If you want me to proceed with (1) or (2) send the vendor details. If we do manual activation I'll run a quick checklist (attached) and log the action in our onboarding audit. Steps I will take if approved:
- Verify vendor identity against TAX ID/DUNS
- Create vendor record and link to Novacorp account
- Mark vendor active and push visibility for the provided PO number
- Emit an audit entry and notify AP contact

Attaching the ops quick-activate checklist.
